title: System
description: packages.system in config.json: the same for every instance.

ini.title: PHP settings
ini.description: Set with ini_set() on every request. Upload limits do not belong here, PHP cannot change them at runtime.

max_execution_time.title: Max. execution time
max_execution_time.description: Seconds a request may run before PHP stops it. 0: no limit.

memory_limit.title: Memory limit
memory_limit.description: How much memory one request may take, e.g. 512M or 1G.

serialize_precision.title: Serialize precision
serialize_precision.description: Digits of floating point numbers in serialize() and json_encode().

log_errors.title: Log errors
log_errors.description: PHP writes its errors to the error log.

html_errors.title: HTML errors
html_errors.description: PHP formats the errors it shows as HTML.

constants.title: Constants
constants.description: Defined as PHP constants when the configuration is loaded.

DEFAULT_TABLE_PREFIX.title: Table Prefix
DEFAULT_TABLE_PREFIX.description: Put before the name of every table of the system: cms_nodes.

PROJECT_NAMESPACE.title: Project namespace
PROJECT_NAMESPACE.description: The PHP namespace of the project's classes. Also names its live update channels when the relay has no prefix.

ACCOUNT_WHITELIST.title: Allowed mail domains
ACCOUNT_WHITELIST.description: Who may create an account. Empty: everybody.

auth.title: Sign-in
auth.description: How people sign in, and how long they stay signed in.

defaultSignInMethod.title: Default sign-in
defaultSignInMethod.description: What the sign-in card opens with. Empty: the person picks.

deviceDays.title: Device days
deviceDays.description: How long a device stays signed in

screenDays.title: Screen days
screenDays.description: How long a screen lives after its last use. Empty: until revoked.
